assessments.reason: Adds a Vercel Ignored Build Step; it decides whether Vercel builds a push and never changes what a build emits
assessments.consumers: vercel.json gains only ignoreCommand; buildCommand is unchanged. scripts/vercel-ignore-build.sh is executed solely by Vercel before cloning into a build (and by tests/vercel-ignore-build.spec.ts in temporary git repositories); nuxt.config.ts, package.json scripts, the Nitro server, pages, components, stores and public assets neither import nor read it. When it exits 1 Vercel runs the identical buildCommand on the identical tree; when it exits 0 Vercel cancels that deployment and the branch keeps its previous successful deployment, whose tree differs only in excluded docs/tests/harness paths that never reach .output. No rendered page, route, store, style or asset changes, so no home, search, product, cart or orders screenshot can observe a difference.

assessments.reason: Full Refund is an internal default-off capability; verify representative existing paid checkout read consumers after additive schema/provider composition changes.
assessments.consumers: The new stripeRefunds.requestFullRefund export has no route, UI, webhook or application caller in this slice. Catalog/product/home templates, styles and money are unchanged; broader screenshots would not exercise this internal operation. No baseline updates.
